item.description:
Remittances increased by 14% YoY to USD 3.9bn during Oct'26
Remittances by overseas Pakistani increased by 14% YoY to USD 3.9bn during Oct'26 compared to USD 3.4bn during Oct’25. On MoM basis, remittances increased by 8%.
In 4MFY27, remittances increased by 14%YoY to USD 14.8bn.
